INSERT INTO bot.persistent_views(message_id, channel_id, guild_id, view_type)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
            ON CONFLICT(message_id) DO UPDATE SET
              channel_id = excluded.channel_id,
              guild_id = excluded.guild_id,
              view_type = excluded.view_type,
              created_at = now()
